recon.landing.helpSummary: Recon is reconnaissance: automatically mapping out a target's attack surface — subdomains, live hosts, crawled URLs, historical URLs, WHOIS/ASN ownership — before you look for vulnerabilities. Every scan runs against a target you've already added to a project.
recon.landing.step1: Open a project, then a target, and click "New scan" to pick a tool (subdomain enumeration, crawler, URL history, WHOIS, ASN lookup) and run it.
recon.landing.step2: Watch progress and live logs while the scan runs.
recon.landing.step3: Review the normalized findings (subdomains, URLs, hosts) — they feed into Vulnerabilities and the Asset Graph automatically.

vuln.help.summary: This is where actual weaknesses are found and tracked — different from Recon (which only maps out what exists). Vulnerability scans test the targets and URLs Recon discovered for real security issues, and every result lands here as a finding with a severity rating.
vuln.help.step1: Pick a scanner under "Scanners" and a target to test, or apply a saved template under "Templates" to run several checks at once.
vuln.help.step2: Track progress under "Scan jobs" while it runs.
vuln.help.step3: Triage results here or under "Findings" — confirm real issues, mark false positives, and hand confirmed ones to Bug Bounty or Reports.

report.title: Security report
report.running: This scan is still running. The report is partial; reload it when the scan finishes.
report.failedScan: This scan did not finish. The report shows what was found before it stopped.
report.scope.apex: {root} and all of its subdomains (DNS ownership proof)
report.scope.host: {root} only (the ownership proof covers this host, not its subdomains)
report.notTested.title: What was NOT tested
report.notTested.intro: A clean result only means nothing was found by the checks that ran. These were not covered:
report.nt.STAGE_FAILED: The "{stage}" stage failed or stopped early{detail}. Its results are partial.
report.nt.NO_AUTH: Pages behind a login were not tested.
report.nt.NO_BUSINESS_LOGIC: Application logic (prices, permissions, workflows) was not tested.
report.nt.HOME_PAGE_ONLY: Only the home page of each address was examined; other pages were not.
report.nt.NO_PORT_SCAN: Open ports and other network services were not scanned.
report.nt.NO_CONTENT_DISCOVERY: Hidden files and directories were not searched for.
report.nt.NO_STORED_XSS: Stored and blind cross-site scripting were not tested.
report.nt.HTTP_TEMPLATES_ONLY: Only web (HTTP) templates were run; TLS, TCP and DNS templates were not.
report.nt.SUBDOMAINS_NOT_COVERED: Subdomains were not scanned: ownership was verified for this host only.
report.verification.NOT_APPLICABLE: Not re-checked (this kind of finding cannot be re-checked safely)
report.verification.FAILED: The re-check could not be completed
report.explainError: Could not explain this finding right now.
report.explained.ai: Written by AI from the check description. The severity is not AI-assigned.
report.method1: Severity is set by the tool that reported the finding and is never changed by Secora or by AI. When two tools report the same issue, the higher of their severities is kept.
report.method2: CONFIRMED means a safe re-check (one GET request, no data changed) reproduced the issue. LIKELY means a tool reported it and it was not, or could not be, re-checked. INFO is informational.
report.method3: The score starts at 100 and loses points per finding (critical 25, high 15, medium 7, low 2), in full for confirmed findings and at 70% for likely ones. A critical or high finding caps the grade.
report.export.pdfNote: The PDF uses Latin letters only. Open the printable report and use "Save as PDF" to keep the original alphabet.
report.share.title: Share this report
report.share.intro: Anyone with the link can read this report until it expires. It lists weaknesses of your site, so share it only with people you trust.
report.share.created: Link created. Copy it now; it is shown only once.
report.share.error: Could not complete that. Try again.
report.public.expired: This link has expired or was revoked.
